title: Investigations into linker effects of DNA–VHL ligand conjugates by multiplexed affinity measurements using focal molography
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, 7,870-879
DOI: 10.1039/D6CB00011H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pascal Raschke, Simona Notova, Volker Gatterdam, Andreas Frutiger, Andreas Brunschweiger
We measured the affinity of linker-diversified DNA–PROTACs to VHL by focal molography. Our analysis validates multiplexed affinity measurements and identifies hydrophobicity of the linker as the primary driver to linker-VHL ligand affinity for VHL.
